description: Upload final show recordings to SoundCloud (private by default) with frontend toggle to make public. Auto-trigger after recording upload, description from AI show bio + artist socials.

steps.task: Add SoundCloud config fields to Config struct in config.rs: soundcloud_client_id, soundcloud_client_secret, soundcloud_access_token (all Option<String>), mapping to SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/ACCESS_TOKEN env vars via envy

Add DB migration columns to shows table in db.rs run_migrations(): soundcloud_track_id TEXT, soundcloud_url TEXT, soundcloud_uploaded_at TEXT, soundcloud_public INTEGER DEFAULT 0, using add_column_if_missing pattern
Update Show struct in models.rs: add soundcloud_track_id: Option<String>, soundcloud_url: Option<String>, soundcloud_uploaded_at: Option<String>, soundcloud_public: Option<bool>
Create soundcloud.rs module with SoundCloud API integration

sub_plan.description: Implement SoundCloud API functions following the established patterns from instagram.rs and telegram_notify.rs

steps.task: Implement get_access_token(config): use client credentials OAuth flow (POST https://secure.soundcloud.com/oauth/token with client_id + client_secret + grant_type=client_credentials), or return static soundcloud_access_token from config if set

Implement build_soundcloud_description(state, show_id): fetch show ai_bio from DB, fetch assigned artists via artist_show_assignments join, for each artist append their soundcloud and instagram handles (if present) as formatted lines, return combined description string

Implement upload_track(state, show_id): fetch show from DB, build title as 'Show Title — Artist A, Artist B', call build_soundcloud_description for description, download recording bytes via storage::download_file(state, &recording_key), download cover via storage::download_file(state, &cover_key), POST multipart form to https://api.soundcloud.com/tracks with title, description, sharing=private, asset_data (audio), artwork_data (cover). On success, UPDATE shows SET soundcloud_track_id, soundcloud_url, soundcloud_uploaded_at

Implement set_track_privacy(state, show_id, public: bool): fetch show from DB, get soundcloud_track_id, PUT https://api.soundcloud.com/tracks/:track_id with sharing=public or sharing=private, UPDATE shows SET soundcloud_public in DB

decisions: Using reqwest with multipart feature (already in Cargo.toml) for SoundCloud API calls
Following instagram.rs pattern: module-level functions taking &Arc<AppState>
Cover image fetched from R2 at shows/{show_id}/cover.png via storage::download_file
Track title format: 'Show Title — Artist A, Artist B' using dash separator

steps.task: Register soundcloud module in main.rs (add mod soundcloud;) and add two API routes: POST /api/shows/:id/soundcloud/upload and POST /api/shows/:id/soundcloud/privacy

Add API handlers in handlers/api.rs: api_upload_to_soundcloud (require_admin, fetch show, call soundcloud::upload_track, return JSON result) and api_set_soundcloud_privacy (require_admin, accept {public: bool}, call soundcloud::set_track_privacy, return JSON result). Follow api_post_show_to_instagram pattern.

Add auto-trigger: in api_upload_show_recording (after DB update at ~L2362) and finalize_recording_upload (after DB update at ~L422), add tokio::spawn background task that checks config.soundcloud_client_id.is_some() then calls soundcloud::upload_track. Fire-and-forget pattern, log success/failure.

decisions: Fire-and-forget pattern (tokio::spawn) — does not block recording upload response
Both upload paths (single + chunked) trigger SoundCloud upload for consistency
Graceful no-op when SoundCloud not configured (config check before spawn)

steps.task: Update show detail API response: add soundcloud_track_id, soundcloud_url, soundcloud_uploaded_at, soundcloud_public fields to the JSON returned by api_get_show_detail. Ensure the SELECT query includes these columns.
Update frontend types and API methods for SoundCloud integration

sub_plan.description: Add SoundCloud fields to frontend types and API client methods

steps.task: Add soundcloud_track_id?: string, soundcloud_url?: string, soundcloud_uploaded_at?: string, soundcloud_public?: boolean to ShowDetail interface in admin/api/index.ts
Add showsApi.uploadToSoundCloud(showId) → POST /api/shows/:id/soundcloud/upload and showsApi.setSoundCloudPrivacy(showId, public) → POST /api/shows/:id/soundcloud/privacy to the API client

Add SoundCloud UI to ShowDetailPage.vue: below the final recording AudioPlayer section, add a SoundCloud status row. If soundcloud_url exists: show clickable link + 'Uploaded ✓' timestamp + toggle button (Make Public/Make Private). If no soundcloud_url but recording_url exists: show 'Upload to SoundCloud' button. Add reactive state (uploadingToSoundCloud, togglingPrivacy) and handler functions following postToInstagram pattern.

decisions: Toggle button placed in recording section (below AudioPlayer), not a separate SoundCloud section
Follows postToInstagram pattern: call API, flash success/error, reload show

steps.task: Verify implementation: cargo build in source/backend to confirm compilation. Test manually: upload a final recording, verify SoundCloud upload triggers in logs, verify soundcloud_track_id populated in DB, verify privacy toggle works via frontend button.

artifacts.path: Manual testing: upload recording → SoundCloud upload triggered → privacy toggle works

steps.task: Document SoundCloud integration in SHARED_KNOWLEDGE.md: configuration (env vars), auto-upload flow, privacy toggle, description format (AI bio + artist socials), track title format
